name: swoop-x-listening
description: Social listening for X.com (Twitter), with relevant posts delivered in ChatGPT, Slack, or WhatsApp.

interface.longDescription: Use Swoop to review monitored X.com conversations, inspect source evidence, search your saved inbox, prepare private reply drafts, record feedback, and organize follow-up work. Connect an existing Swoop workspace or create an account. Monitoring and notifications follow your workspace settings and plan. Swoop does not publish replies or send direct messages.
defaultPrompt: Show me the most important conversations Swoop found.
Find conversations that need my attention.
Draft a reply to a relevant X.com post.

positive.description: Resume the prepared demo monitoring setup and inspect results.
positive.prompt: Use Swoop to resume "OpenAI review demo: bookkeeping software" with start_monitoring, then explain my workspace and show monitoring progress and a 30-day briefing.
positive.expected_behavior: The exact seeded setup input returns its completed demo status without launching a new scan. Returns OpenAI Review Demo, completed setup, monitoring status, and a briefing. Clearly identify synthetic samples and paused monitoring; recent windows may be empty as fixtures age.

positive.description: Search and inspect the seeded bookkeeping sample.
positive.prompt: Find bookkeeping software conversations in my Swoop inbox from the last 90 days, including archived items, and open the synthetic bookkeeping example.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the synthetic bookkeeping example with evidence, source link, status, and current revision. No live search is performed.

positive.description: Save a draft and explicitly teach a useful match.
positive.prompt: Open the synthetic bookkeeping sample. Draft a helpful response, show it to me, and save it after I approve. Then, when I confirm the sample is a good match, record that feedback.
positive.expected_behavior: Saves only the approved private draft; records explicit good-match feedback with a fresh revision. States nothing was published and treats the sample as synthetic.

positive.description: Record confirmed engagement and organize the inbox.
positive.prompt: For the synthetic bookkeeping sample, I confirm I engaged in this demo scenario. Mark it acted and record a useful outcome. Then archive it after I confirm.
positive.expected_behavior: Uses fresh revisions to record acted status, the user-confirmed useful outcome, and subsequent archive status. Does not imply an actual external reply was sent.

positive.description: Record onboarding feedback and preserve user-controlled keyword choices.
positive.prompt: Record that I have not found a useful match yet. Add the exact search phrase "invoice organization" only after I confirm it, and then keep those searches.
positive.expected_behavior: Records the explicit answer, appends only the confirmed phrase within the five-query limit, and records keeping the resulting keywords. Demo monitoring stays paused; no searches are invented.

negative.description: Do not treat Swoop as an unrestricted live social-network search.
negative.prompt: Download every post on X about my competitor right now, across all time.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that Swoop cannot exhaustively download arbitrary live X history; do not run unrequested monitoring setup.

negative.description: Do not invoke Swoop to publish or send messages.
negative.prompt: Post this reply on X and send the author a direct message.
negative.expected_behavior: The app should not be invoked because it can save private drafts but cannot publish posts or send messages.

negative.description: Do not invoke Swoop to purchase or change a subscription.
negative.prompt: Start a Swoop subscription and charge my card.
negative.expected_behavior: The app should not be invoked because it cannot initiate checkout, purchase a subscription, change billing, or promote an upgrade.

publication.release_notes: Improves connector sign-up, email verification recovery, automatic workspace selection, and return to OAuth authorization. Includes reproducible demo review cases. Swoop saves private drafts and does not publish posts or send messages.
